newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain to introduce bill to strengthen competition.
newsitem.headline: Spain to introduce bill to strengthen competition.

text.p: The Spanish government is to present a new bill before the end of the year to strengthen business competition, Economy Secretary Cristobal Montoro said on Friday.
"The government will present a bill to parliament before year end, aimed at changing the current Defence of Competition Law," Montoro said in a Economics Ministry statement to a Barcelona seminar.

"(It will be) based on strengthening competition and those entities (responsible for) defending it, as well as improving the process for sanctions to be taken against those who break the rules," he said. -- Madrid Newsroom, + 341 585 8340
